read.title: NiiDo Read
read.subtitle: Discover how your student learns best
read.aboutYouSubtitle: Tell us a little about yourself
read.gradeLabel: What's your current level of education?
read.publicHeroSubtitle: A free, friendly assessment for learners of any age — no account needed to start. Answer a few quick questions and discover your own learning style.
read.publicNote: Takes about 5–8 minutes · Your results are private
read.encourageBody1: There's no right or wrong here — every answer helps build a picture of how you like to take in new things.
read.encourageBody2: Lots of learners find that pictures, sounds, or hands-on practice make ideas click in very different ways. Yours is just as valid.
read.encourageTitle3: So close — just a little more!
read.encourageBody3: Knowing how you learn best can make schoolwork feel a lot less like a struggle, and a lot more like you.
read.completeBody: We've got everything we need to build your learning profile.
